infestusfrontier.refusal.storage.full: No room for a whole bucket
infestusfrontier.refusal.storage.empty: Not a whole bucket to take
infestusfrontier.refusal.storage.wrong_f: This organ does not take that fluid
infestusfrontier.refusal.processing.busy: Still working on the last batch
infestusfrontier.refusal.processing.not_: This organ makes biomass. It does not take it
infestusfrontier.refusal.organ.unreadabl: This organ's saved data cannot be read. It keeps it and refuses commands
infestusfrontier.refusal.equipment.nothi: Needs biomass in the Bladder and an awakened piece with room in the slot
A first guide to the living colony.
category.infestusfrontier.contact.name: First Contact
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.the_wakin: This guide covers the starting ingredients and how the colony grows only where you choose. Each page names what you need first. Nothing here is required to play. Read a page when you want to know what to do next.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.organ_bud: A blank that becomes an organ
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.surgical_: Organs are hard to break: about 18 seconds with a hand or any ordinary tool, so a stray click never takes one. A broken organ comes out whole, with everything it holds and every batch it has done, ready to place again. The Surgical Blade cuts an organ out in a second and a half and lasts 64 uses, worn by anything it breaks. Grown tissue is different: veins, Mouths and beds never move, and a broken cell dies into Dead Tissue.
An iron ingot, a bone and a Membrane Sheet make the blade.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.speak_to_: Read an organ without opening it
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.a_culture: Rotten flesh, a red mushroom and wheat seeds.
Use Spore Culture on exposed dirt, grass, mud or stone to turn it into basic Living Substrate. Lost this book? Craft it again from a book and one Spore Culture.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_su: Bone meal grows a cell. The fed cell matures and converts the ground beside it: a mature core, a young ring, a basic edge. Bone meal the edge to grow on. Cells never spread on their own. Grown tissue never moves: a broken cell dies into Dead Tissue, whatever the tool, and so does everything grown in a cell.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_wa: Walls are grown, never placed. Sneak and use bone meal on a mature cell: a Living Wall grows on it. Bone meal on the top of a wall grows it one block higher, one block a bone meal. Like every grown cell, a broken wall dies into Dead Tissue, and no piston moves it.

Grafts harden a wall one block at a time. A Skeletal Graft turns a Living Wall into a Ribbed Wall, tougher than stone. A Calcifying Graft turns a Ribbed Wall into a Calcified Wall, which no explosion breaks; a pickaxe takes it down fastest. The Activation Cyst makes both grafts.
A wall opens by mutation. Use a Membrane Window on a wall cell of any tier: it turns to veined, translucent membrane in a bone frame, and windows side by side join into one pane. Use a Sphincter Door on a wall cell with another wall cell above or below it: the two become a doorway whose membrane flaps draw back into the rim, by hand or by redstone. A Sphincter Door is a simple door: villagers open it, and zombies can break it down. A Skeletal Graft on it grows bone ribs into a Clenched Door, which opens only by redstone, like an iron door, so put a button or lever beside it; no mob opens or breaks it. A Calcifying Graft then plates it into a Calcified Door, which no explosion breaks; like any door it stands on the block below, so give it a floor as hard. Broken, every opening dies into Dead Tissue.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.organ_bud: Spore Culture, two rotten flesh and bone meal.
Place a Bud on Living Substrate. Craft an organ from it. The Culture Bowl grows Buds in batches.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.digestive: An Organ Bud, two rotten flesh and a bowl.

Place it on Living Substrate. Feed it by hand or by hopper: wheat gives 100 BU in 2 seconds, rotten flesh 50 BU in 8, Dead Tissue 5 BU in 4. An empty bucket takes 1000 BU. Any other item opens the screen. A full Sac waits.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.biomass_b: An Organ Bud, two glass and a slime ball.
Holds 4000 BU. A biomass bucket pours in, an empty bucket takes out. A Sac beside it fills it on its own. Any other item opens the screen.
An empty bucket on a Sac or a Bladder takes 1000 BU. Use the full bucket on a Bladder or a Bowl to pour it in. One BU is one mB.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.culture_b: A flower pot, Spore Culture and wheat seeds.

Place it on Living Substrate. Put ingredients in one at a time, or let a hopper load it, and pour water from a bucket. A batch starts on its own when the ingredients are complete and takes 60 seconds; spare ingredients wait for the next. Any other item opens the screen. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.speak_to_: A bone, a slime ball and Spore Culture.

Use the Probe on an organ to read its biomass without opening the screen. Any other item, or an empty hand, opens the screen: what the organ holds and how far its work has come. Sneak to build against an organ.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.membrane_: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in rotten flesh or leather and string, by hand or by hopper, and pour water from a bucket. It starts on its own. A sheet takes 20 seconds from flesh, 40 from leather. Any other item opens the screen. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back.
Two sticks, two bones and Spore Culture.
gui.infestusfrontier.stage.story: %s more batches to the next stage
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.bio_furna: Smelt with biomass; it grows with use

Place it on Living Substrate. Put in anything a furnace smelts, by hand or by hopper, and a bucket of biomass. It starts on its own: 40 BU and 16 seconds per item, the normal result. Any other item opens the screen. The smelting experience waits in the furnace, up to 1000 points, for whoever takes the result.

Every batch it completes counts. At 64 the furnace reaches its second stage and smelts in 12 seconds; at 512 its third, in 8. The body grows ridges, then lobes and chimneys. The count travels with the furnace when it is broken and placed again.
A furnace, an Organ Bud and two Membrane Sheets.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.bone_loom: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in bones, by hand or by hopper, and a bucket of biomass. It starts on its own. A plate takes 20 seconds and 50 BU. Biomass binds the bone; it does not make it. Any other item opens the screen. Sneak with both hands empty to take a stack back.
An Organ Bud, two bones and two sticks.
item.infestusfrontier.living_tool.mutati: Contractile: breaks the 3×3 round each block it mines, 2 BU each
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_to: Bone tools that wake and mend

Bone Plates on sticks, in the shape of a pickaxe, axe, shovel or hoe, make a dormant tool. It digs what a stone tool digs and wears out after 96 blocks; an anvil mends it with Bone Plates. The Cradle wakes it, as it wakes a piece of armor: a Spore Culture and 100 BU, thirty seconds, as worn as it went in.
Three plates over a stick for a pick; two and one beside the stick for a hatchet; one for a spade; two for a hoe.

A living tool lasts 256 blocks and carries 40 BU, filled at a Biomass Bladder. While you carry it, it mends four points of wear a second, one BU each, until the reserve is dry. No material repairs it on an anvil.

A living pick, hatchet or spade with a Contractile Fiber and 200 BU in the Cradle takes its one branch. Each block it mines, it also breaks the eight round it on the face you struck, those it is the right tool for, as if you had broken them yourself, for 2 BU each from its reserve. Dry, it mines one block at a time. The branch is permanent and the tool keeps its wear and reserve.
item.infestusfrontier.living_tool.mutati: Grasping: a hit grips its target, Slowness II for three seconds, 2 BU each
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.living_fa: A bone blade that wakes and grips

Two Bone Plates on a stick make a Dormant Fang: a weak blade, a wooden sword's bite, 96 strikes, mended with Bone Plates on an anvil. The Cradle wakes it as it wakes a tool: a Spore Culture and 100 BU, thirty seconds, as worn as it went in. A Living Fang bites a little harder, lasts 256 strikes, carries 40 BU filled at a Biomass Bladder, and mends itself from them while you carry it.

A Living Fang with a Contractile Fiber and 200 BU in the Cradle takes its one branch. Each hit grips: the target is slowed, Slowness II for three seconds, for 2 BU from the reserve. Dry, it only cuts. The branch is permanent and the fang keeps its wear and reserve.
death.attack.infestusfrontier.spine: %1$s was lashed by a Spine Sentry
death.attack.infestusfrontier.spine.play: %1$s was lashed by a Spine Sentry while fighting %2$s
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.spine: A rooted lash that guards the colony

Place it on Living Substrate and feed it biomass by bucket or vein. Every second it lashes the nearest hostile it can see within six blocks and three up or down, three hearts a strike, for 10 BU. Players, villagers and animals are never struck. Dry, it rests; biomass arriving wakes it.

What a creature it kills drops goes into its eight wells before it can fall; only what does not fit falls. A hopper, a Mouth set to output or a Yield Lobe takes the wells; nothing fills them. With no empty well left it rests until a well is emptied.
An Organ Bud, a crossbow and two Bone Plates.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.dormant_p: Rotten flesh in the shape of a helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots makes a dormant piece. It is weak and holds nothing. The Cradle wakes it.
entry.infestusfrontier.contact.awakening: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in a dormant piece, a Spore Culture and a bucket of biomass. It starts on its own. Thirty seconds and 100 BU later the piece is awake, as worn as it went in, with an empty reserve of 40 BU. Any other item opens the screen.
Open a Biomass Bladder, put the awakened piece in its slot and press Fill. The Bladder moves what the piece can take, 40 BU at most, and nothing else.
An Organ Bud, two Bone Plates and two Membrane Sheets.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.awa: Wake a dormant piece in an Awakening Cradle.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.roo: The colony begins with a single culture.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.liv: Use a Spore Culture on exposed ground.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.org: Craft or grow an Organ Bud, a blank that becomes an organ.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.dig: Digest a batch in a Digestive Sac for your first fuel; a full Sac pauses instead of spilling.
advancement.infestusfrontier.contact.bio: Pour a bucket of biomass into a Biomass Bladder to store it.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.activ: Place it on Living Substrate. Put in the ingredients of one treatment, by hand or by hopper, with water and biomass from buckets. It starts on its own and takes 20 seconds. The Bowl makes Fusion Binder, Elastic Gel and Rooting Gel too, in 60. Any other item opens the screen.

Fusion Binder and Elastic Gel are ingredients of the other treatments. Capillary Gel grows a Biomass Vein out of a cell of mature Living Substrate, Contractile Fiber an Item Vein, Filter Membrane a Fluid Vein that Sealing Resin then seals. Rooting Gel and Synaptic Gel are made for the crop beds and the nerves that come with the next organs; until then they are kept, not used.
An Organ Bud, two Membrane Sheets and a Bone Plate.
gui.infestusfrontier.vascular_junction.p: Click a face with the Synaptic Probe to cycle it: closed, intake, outlet
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.bioma: A green lumen that carries biomass

Use Capillary Gel on exposed mature Living Substrate. Veins connect biomass stores and organs into a passive network on floors, walls and ceilings. A Junction transfers between loaded endpoints. Veins hold no biomass and do no pumping of their own; loops and branches only establish connections.

Full destinations refuse transfers, leaving biomass at its source. Known vein connections can cross unloaded chunks, but unloaded stores and organs are unavailable. Unknown terrain must load before a connection can be discovered. The probe reports discovery and the 1024-cell network limit. Breaking a vein leaves Dead Tissue; stored biomass stays in the organs.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.item_: Use Contractile Fiber on an exposed cell of mature Living Substrate. An Item Vein holds nothing itself: it joins Mouths into one network, along floors, up walls and around corners. A Mouth set to output sends a store's items through it to the Mouths set to intake that take them.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.septu: Two routes through one cell, unmixed

Use the graft on a vein to create two independent straight passages. Each belongs to its own network; they never join or hold contents. The clicked face shows both lumens and has no passage. The probe turns the crossing; sneak with the probe to read a passage. Seal Fluid Veins before grafting. Breaking it leaves Dead Tissue.
A Membrane Sheet and a Bone Plate make the graft.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.vascu: Carries a vein over a step

Place it in the corner of a one-block step between veins of the same carrier. It connects the two cells as one network, including upside down under a ceiling. It holds nothing and drops off when either supporting cell goes.
Contractile Fiber and a Membrane Sheet make one stitch.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.fluid: Use Filter Membrane on exposed mature Living Substrate, then seal the vein with Sealing Resin. Sealed veins connect compatible liquid endpoints; they own no fluid. A Vascular Junction can draw from or supply the network. Each tank keeps its own liquid; liquids never silently mix. Ordinary Fluid Veins refuse biomass, hot fluids and gases.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.vascu: The pump: intakes, outlets, closed mouths

Place it on Living Substrate. Click a face with the Synaptic Probe to make it an intake, an outlet or closed; the mouth shows it. Every 4 ticks it drains up to 250 mB from each intake, a Bladder, a Sac, a vein or a water source block, into its 1000 mB tank, and pushes as much out of each outlet into a vein, a tank or an organ. It holds one liquid at a time. Any hand opens its screen; sneak with the probe to read it.
An Organ Bud, two Membrane Sheets and a slime ball.
gui.infestusfrontier.vascular_junction.t: One liquid at a time, 1000 mB. Intakes fill it, outlets drain it, 250 mB every 4 ticks.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.mouth: Connect a store to the living workshop

Place a Mouth under a chest or organ. Item Veins and Mouths touching its sides form the network. Intake receives items; output offers them to accepting intakes, highest priority first, rotating equal priorities. Both handles organ ingredients and products. Transfers happen directly between loaded stores. Open the Mouth, or probe its store, to configure it.
One Bud, one hopper and one Membrane Sheet. Nine filter slots allow or deny items. An amount keeps that many in an output's store, or fills an intake's store up to it.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.filter.story: Click an item into a slot to list it; click a slot with an empty hand to clear it. An empty filter passes everything.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.carried.story: Undelivered items retained after a destination refused execution. Saved here and retried without extracting more.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.mode.story: Intake: the network fills the store above. Output: the network takes from it. Both: for an organ, which takes ingredients and gives only products. Closed: neither; items still pass through.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.list.story: Allow: only the listed items pass. Deny: everything but them.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.amount.story: Intake fills the store up to this many of each item; output leaves this many in it. Shift-click lowers.
gui.infestusfrontier.mouth.priority.stor: Higher-priority intakes are served first. Equal priorities take turns regardless of distance. Shift-click lowers.
Hoppers, mouths and planters leave this many of each kind. A stick raises it by one; after 64 it starts again at 0.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.culti: A crop bed grown from substrate

Use Rooting Gel on an exposed cell of mature Living Substrate. Any crop plants on the bed as on farmland. It holds 1000 mB of water from a bucket or a Fluid Vein; while it has water the crop grows as on wet farmland, and the bed drinks a sip now and then. It plants nothing and harvests nothing.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.seed_: Place it on Living Substrate. It holds four kinds of planting stock, a stack of each, put in by hand, hopper or mouth. A stick raises the reserve by one, from 64 back to 0. Hoppers, mouths and planters take only what a kind has beyond the reserve. Any other item opens the screen, where you take what you like. Breaking it spills the stock.
Leather, a Membrane Sheet and Spore Culture.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.plant: Place it on Living Substrate. Its plot is the nine cells under and around it. Every second it plants one seed on the first empty Cultivation Tissue of the plot, for 5 BU: from its own slot first, then from any chest or Seed Pouch beside it, above the pouch's reserve. Seeds go in by hand, hopper or mouth; biomass by bucket or vein. A seed that cannot stand there costs nothing.
An Organ Bud, a wooden hoe, Rooting Gel and a Membrane Sheet.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.harve: Cuts the ripe crops around it

Place it on Living Substrate. Its plot is the nine cells under and around it. Every second it cuts one ripe crop of the plot into its four slots, the same drops a hand would get, for 5 BU. It never replants: a Planting Proboscis does. When the drops do not fit, the crop waits. An Output Mouth, a hopper or a vein takes the harvest; nothing goes in by hand.
An Organ Bud, an iron hoe and two Membrane Sheets.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.compo: Place it on Living Substrate. Four seeds or four leaf blocks and 100 mB of water make one bone meal in 20 seconds. It starts on its own; a hopper or a mouth loads it. What goes to compost cannot also go to the Sac.
A composter, an Organ Bud and a Membrane Sheet.
infestusfrontier.status.lobe.no_organ: No organ to serve: face it at an organ's side
infestusfrontier.status.lobe.serving: Serves the %s: lobe %s of the %s its stage takes
infestusfrontier.status.lobe.idle: Idle: the %s takes %s of this kind at its stage
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.feedi: Place it on a foundation beside an organ; it turns to face it and joins it. Whatever reaches the lobe goes into the organ, which keeps only what its next batch can use. Stand it on a Mouth set to intake and the network feeds the organ. A young organ takes one lobe of each kind, and one more for each stage it grows. Use it to read its state.
An Organ Bud, a Membrane Sheet and a slime ball.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.yield: Place it on a foundation beside an organ; it joins it. It gives what the organ has finished and never its ingredients. Stand it on a Mouth set to output and the network carries the products away. Feeding and Yield Lobes make an organ a small factory: plan where they and their Mouths go.
An Organ Bud, a Membrane Sheet and a Bone Plate.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.tread: Ground that feels who stands on it
Synaptic Gel and a spider eye make the graft.

Use the graft on mature Living Substrate with nothing on top: the cell grows a pad of nerve bulbs, flush with the ground. It is a pressure plate in the ground. Any creature standing on it presses it, as on a stone plate, and it springs back within a second after the last one steps off; items do not press it. Pressed, it powers every block beside and below it, and those pass the power one block on, as any powered block does; the block on top gets a little too. So put it in front of a door, beside the cell the door stands on, and the door opens for whoever walks up. Mobs press it too: a Clenched Door with a receptor outside opens for zombies. Broken, it dies into Dead Tissue.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.senso: An eye that reads how full a block is
An Organ Bud, a comparator and a spider eye.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.fuel_: Use it on an exposed cell of mature Living Substrate: the cell becomes a pad, flush with the ground. It holds one packet, 250 BU, which a Biomass Vein or a Junction keeps topped up (a bucket is more than it holds); a Filter Valve keeps your source's reserve. Once a second it fills the chosen worn awakened pieces of one player standing on it, 10 BU at most, plus a fifth for overhead. Use it to choose the pieces and how full.
Capillary Gel and a Membrane Sheet make the graft.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.senso: Place it against the block to watch: beside it on the floor, or on top of it. Every half second it reads how full that block is, biomass first, then any fluid, then items, as a power of 0 to 15, 1 at least for anything at all; its eye lights up when it reads anything. The power comes out of every other side, as weak redstone and as a comparator value. Put a chest in front and a redstone lamp beside it, and the lamp tells you something is there.
Whether the pad fills this worn piece.
The pad fills each chosen piece up to this share of its capacity.
infestusfrontier.status.filter_valve: Keeps %s mB in the store it faces
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.filte: Place it on a foundation facing a store: a Bladder, a Sac, a tank. Drain the store through the valve with a Junction intake or a bucket on its other sides, and the valve stops it at the reserve. Filling goes through. A stick steps the reserve: none, 250, 500, 1000 up to 16000 mB, then none again. Any other hand reads it.
A Bone Plate, a slime ball and paper.
infestusfrontier.refusal.storage.body_ou: Part of this reservoir is not loaded or is still forming
gui.infestusfrontier.reservoir_cell.body: %s cells in one full box share one tank. It fills from the bottom layer and drains from the top. A whole row or layer grows it, up to 4 on a side; a cell that would leave a gap waits outside with its own biomass.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.reser: Bladders that grow into one tank

A cell holds 4000 BU and stands on a foundation such as Living Substrate, on another cell or on a Vascular Junction. Touching cells that fill a whole box, up to 4 on a side, become one body: the walls between them go, and biomass fills the bottom layer first and drains from the top. Grow it by whole rows and layers; a cell that would leave a gap waits outside with its own biomass. A bucket, vein or junction on any cell reaches the whole body. A broken cell keeps its own share.
A Biomass Bladder, two Bone Plates and two Membrane Sheets. The cell keeps what the Bladder held.
gui.infestusfrontier.item_capsule.body.s: One store for the whole stem. Every stem cell opens all of its pods; a pod opens only itself.
gui.infestusfrontier.item_capsule.growth: Bone meal on any cell feeds the root. A growth at the first level costs one; each level up costs twice as much, thirty-two at the sixth. A lost cell or pod is regrown first, at its level's cost.
gui.infestusfrontier.item_capsule.pod.tr: A Skeletal Graft put here grows the pod a grade: sixteen stacks, then thirty-two. Spare grafts come back when the screen closes; at the last grade a shift-clicked graft is stored like any item.
gui.infestusfrontier.item_capsule.pod.fi: This pod alone: click or shift-click to take a stack or put items in. Any stem cell opens the whole stem.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.item_: A stem that grows pods, each a store of one kind

Plant a Capsule Stem on Living Substrate or a ground organ and bone meal it: the stem rises, forks once and grows pods on its trunk, two to four a tier, up to six tiers and sixteen pods. A pod holds one kind of item, eight stacks when young; its face shows the kind and the count. Any stem cell opens the whole stem; a pod opens only itself, a stack in or out and a treatment well; hoppers, pipes and Mouths at the root reach every pod, filling a kind's own pod before an empty one.
A chest, two Membrane Sheets and a Spore Culture make a stem. Pods grow; none is crafted.
gui.infestusfrontier.item_capsule.page.s: Browse the whole stem. Put down carried items before changing pages.
entry.infestusfrontier.circulation.item_: Bone meal on any cell feeds the root. A growth at the first level costs one bone meal; each level up costs twice as much, thirty-two at the sixth. A lost cell or pod is regrown first. Bone meal where nothing fits is kept. A Skeletal Graft, used on a pod or put in its treatment well, grows it a grade: sixteen stacks, then thirty-two.

A broken trunk cell leaves Dead Tissue and orphans the pods above it until bone meal regrows it in place; a broken pod comes out whole with its stock and can be pressed back on the trunk; a broken root, or one dug out from under, kills the stem from the bottom up, each dying cell shedding its pods as items with their contents.
infestusfrontier.status.network.unavaila: unavailable; topology changed or knowledge limit reached
